shell_commands: ls -la src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 || echo "File does not exist"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(tools): compile schemas at registration and validate input at execution

Add AJV for JSON Schema validation. Compile static tool schemas at register time
(throwing on invalid schema naming the tool), cache compiled validators for
function-valued schemas by reference, and validate input against the schema in
execute before invoking the tool executor. Schema validation rejects required,
type, and enum violations without coercion, defaults, or additionalProperties
checks, returning a ToolResponse with field paths and constraints (no values).
EOF
)"
git add .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "mark schema compilation and validation facets as complete" && git push origin HEAD
